verdict.rationale: Insomnia is described as an open-source desktop app for designing/testing APIs (kong-docs-6) and Kong Gateway supports a fully local, declarative 'DB-less' deployment via Docker without needing Konnect cloud (kong-gh-7, kong-gh-4), suggesting a local workspace path exists. However, evidence also shows organizations/cloud sync and a Konnect signup flow (kong-gh-12, kong-docs-41) implying cloud-account features are prominent, and there is no explicit doc stating full offline operation without any account. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that Insomnia/collections work fully offline with zero cloud account requirement, and confirmation that all collection/workspace features (not just design) function without sign-in.
